view.sponge.title: Sponge state
view.sponge.missing: This lab does not record a sponge state.
view.sponge.notYet: Nothing absorbed yet – step forward to start. The grid shows the state before the first step.
view.sponge.sizes: Rate: {{rateLanes}} lanes ({{rateBits}} bits) · capacity: {{capacityLanes}} lanes ({{capacityBits}} bits)
view.sponge.legend.rate: rate: takes the input, gives the output
view.sponge.legend.capacity: capacity: never input or output directly
view.sponge.orientation: x runs left → right and y top → bottom. FIPS 202 figures draw lane (0, 0) in the centre instead.
view.sponge.formula.pad: P = N ‖ pad10*1(r, len(N)), with N = M ‖ 01 for SHA-3 and N = M ‖ 1111 for SHAKE
view.sponge.formula.rho: A′[x, y, z] = A[x, y, (z − (t + 1)(t + 2)/2) mod w], where (x, y) runs from (1, 0) by (x, y) ← (y, (2x + 3y) mod 5) for t = 0 … 23; A′[0, 0, z] = A[0, 0, z]
view.sponge.formula.pi: A′[x, y, z] = A[(x + 3y) mod 5, x, z]
view.sponge.formula.iota: A′[0, 0, z] = A[0, 0, z] ⊕ RC[z], with RC[2^j − 1] = rc(j + 7iᵣ) for j = 0 … ℓ
view.sponge.formula.permute: Keccak-p[b, nᵣ]: Rnd(A, iᵣ) for iᵣ = 12 + 2ℓ − nᵣ … 12 + 2ℓ − 1
view.sponge.what.pad: The message is padded to whole rate blocks. The state is still all zeros.
view.sponge.what.absorb: The next message block is XORed into the rate lanes. The capacity lanes stay untouched.
view.sponge.what.theta: θ XORs each lane with the parities of two neighbouring columns, so every bit soon depends on many others.
view.sponge.what.rho: ρ rotates each lane by its own fixed offset; lane (0, 0) stays put.
view.sponge.what.pi: π moves whole lanes to new positions; the values themselves stay the same.
view.sponge.what.chi: χ combines each lane with the next two in its row: a ⊕ (¬b ∧ c). It is the only non-linear step.
view.sponge.what.iota: ι XORs a round constant into lane (0, 0), so the rounds differ from each other.
view.sponge.what.round: One whole round: θ, ρ, π, χ and ι in one step.
view.sponge.what.permute: The whole permutation: all rounds in one step.
view.sponge.what.squeeze: The rate is read out as output bytes. The capacity never leaves the state.
view.sponge.what.output: The output is the first bytes read from the rate.
view.sponge.spoken.iota: XORed with the round constant RC
view.sponge.theta.rows: Column parities C and the values D
view.sponge.detail.absorbCapacity: {{lane}} is part of the capacity: the block never touches it.
view.sponge.detail.theta: Column {{x}}: D[{{x}}] = C[{{left}}] ⊕ ROT(C[{{right}}], 1), then every lane of column {{x}} ⊕= D[{{x}}]
view.sponge.selectHint: Hover or tap a lane, or use the arrow keys, to select a lane, its column and its row.
view.sponge.output.title: Output bytes in byte order, read from the rate
view.sponge.output.endianness: Lanes are little-endian: the first output byte is the lowest byte of lane (0, 0), i.e. its last two hex digits.
